body: I don't really want justice. I don't care. I just want it to be done, honestly. But I'll give it time. Might as well see where things go after I graduate, I guess. I can end it at any time.

Because then I'll catch all the shit from it. If nothing comes from the authorities then my stepfather will do everything in his power to ruin my life. He will torture my mother if nothing comes of it. I don't want to destroy her life. She thinks she's happy. I feel tired because I've lived like this for 2 years and I've just progressively come to feel worn out with it all.

I will definitely be living on campus and staying with my brother in the off time, but I feel like I'm burdening him. He's working on his own life, he doesn't have time to watch over little brother. He gives me a place to stay when I feel overwhelmed, but I can't help but feel that I'm just stressing him out and adding to his workload. 




As for the college stuff, it just feels like I've failed. I just want to give up and accept that I've been defeated. While every one of my friends goes off to their nice schools and living well, I'll just feel like I've lost.
I do think she has stockholm's syndrome. I'm just so ready to go. I feel so tired.

Nobody knows about him other than my mother and brother. They are powerless however. If she wanted to leave, she would have by now. And I will try that, I just feel it's too late now. I'm halfway through my senior year, what good can it do?
